sentences.hz: 今天，妈妈在家做饭，爸爸做菜，我和姐姐坐在椅子上。
sentences.py: Jīn tiān, māma zài jiā zuò fàn, bàba zuò cài, wǒ hé jiějie zuò zài yǐzi shàng.
sentences.en: Today, Mom cooks at home, Dad prepares the vegetables, and my older sister and I sit on the chairs.

sentences.hz: 今天有米饭和菜，大家都很高兴。
sentences.py: Jīn tiān yǒu mǐfàn hé cài, dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.en: Today there is rice and food, and everyone is very happy.

sentences.hz: 妈妈叫大家吃饭，爸爸说今天菜很好吃。
sentences.py: Māma jiào dàjiā chī fàn, bàba shuō jīn tiān cài hěn hǎo chī.
sentences.en: Mom calls everyone to eat, and Dad says today's food is delicious.

sentences.hz: 我说“家人一起吃饭，我很高兴。”
sentences.py: Wǒ shuō “jiā rén yì qǐ chī fàn, wǒ hěn gāo xìng.”
sentences.en: I say, “I am very happy when the family eats together.”

sentences.hz: 吃饭后，妈妈看电视，爸爸读书，我和姐姐说话。
sentences.py: Chī fàn hòu, māma kàn diàn shì, bàba dú shū, wǒ hé jiějie shuō huà.
sentences.en: After dinner, Mom watches television, Dad reads, and my sister and I talk.
